walk_right.review_notes: Revision 2: eight frames at 10 fps, subtle head bob, arm swing and tail sway. Review the foot exchange and loop seam before approving. Previous six-frame files are preserved.

walk_right.review_notes: First motion test, not production-approved. Check support-leg exchange, foot sliding and the 6-to-1 seam. Native 96x64 trial canvas; master palette matching and final gameplay footprint remain for art review.

run_right.review_notes: Low pursuit run test: six poses at 12 fps with a small open/close jaw cycle. Check leg exchange and foot contact before approval. Pose approved in chat; animation pending.
12-frame revision: six added leg transitions, torso rock, delayed head and tail sway, breathing jaw. 20 fps / 0.6 second loop. Review naturalness and foot exchange; not yet approved.

run_down.review_notes: First directional review: 16 frames at 25 fps. Eight generated keys with Aseprite-controlled foot-depth exchange and body sway. Check anatomy, perspective, hand/foot overlap and tail occlusion. Not yet approved.

Review batch 2: Complete leg poses, ordered support exchange, grounded feet. Review gait and tail overlap. Prepared and checked at native resolution; awaiting your visual approval. Visual reservation: the lifted leg still has strong perspective foreshortening; compare its readability against the walk.

20-frame cycle at 25 FPS (0.8 seconds). Stable body artwork, complete legs and constant-size feet; controlled motion replaces the changing generated poses. Check at 1x and 4x. Revision 3, awaiting your review.

Revision 4: 20 frames at 36 FPS, 0.56 seconds per cycle (previously 0.8 seconds). Stronger leg drive and body dip; complete rigid-size feet. Front run adds counter-swinging arms. Awaiting your visual review.
